name: analyzing-m-and-a-tax-implications
description: Evaluates income tax effects of buying or selling a business and of reorganizations: stock or asset purchase; step-up elections (338(h)(10), 336(e), 338(g)); pre-sale reorganizations such as an F reorganization before a sale; converting a corporation into an LLC, a taxable liquidation or deemed sale; 368 reorganizations and continuity of interest; 1060 allocation and Form 8594; acquired losses and Section 382; and 280G. Covers tax treatment of deferred, contingent, earnout and rollover consideration (453, 453A, 351, 721, 368); deal withholding (FIRPTA 1445 certificates and withholding, backup withholding on payments to sellers); analysis behind tax representations, tax indemnity and straddle-period allocation; and tax audits, elections and open tax matters disclosed in schedules or found in diligence. Routes entity choice, S corporation eligibility, QSBS and consolidated-group questions to analyzing-corporate-tax-structures and compensatory withholding on option cash-outs to analyzing-compensation-tax.
